name: Sumeru Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Sumeru Industries Ltd provides management services and does trading in products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company was engaged in trading of fabric particularly cotton fabric but due to Covid induced uncertainty, company was unable to do business for a long period of time. In FY22, company received an order to provide consultancy services. SIL is in continuous process of identifying new business opportunities

cons: Company has a low return on equity of 0.32% over last 3 years.
